perspective:
**Ethan Mohamud’s available information:**

- Ethan is a plumber and Gary Guo is his long-time friend from middle school; Gary is a doctor. They have stayed close and rely on each other for support.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan became concerned about Gary’s health.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation. He told Gary that his health matters, that he hated seeing him like this, and that two days might give him a new perspective.
- Ethan heard Gary decline, saying he appreciated the concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary behaving restlessly and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected Gary’s overworking involved more than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Ethan heard Gary say it was complicated and that he didn’t want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- After the confrontation, Gary opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan felt relief and empathy.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities. He heard Gary agree and say he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and challenges, and offered support and encouragement.
- Ethan heard Gary say things were better, that Ethan’s help made him less overwhelmed, and that he had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan felt hopeful and proud.
- After a year, Ethan saw that Gary had adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and could manage on his own. Ethan felt satisfied and happy.
- Ethan decided to step back but told Gary he was always just a call away and that he knew Gary had this.
- Ethan heard Gary thank him, say he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control.
